issues.quote: Gross profit increased to $171.7 billion in fiscal 2023 from $135.6 billion in fiscal 2022
issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2023 gross profit was about $146.1 billion, not $171.7 billion. $171.7B would mean a margin of about 81%, which contradicts the 68.9% stated in the same sentence. 68.9% does match $146.1B.

data.summary: Almost everything checks out: revenue ($211.9B vs. $198.3B, up 6.9%), operating income and margin, net income, EPS and R&D. The one error is FY2023 gross profit, which was about $146.1B, not $171.7B.
